name: Budget fit, wrong answers, and the visit hand-off
intent: A 3 BHK buyer with a ₹50–70L ceiling. Every assertion below is a claim the bot should be able to make honestly, or decline. Reproduced from a real dev conversation.

turns.say: self-use home, budget 50-70L, looking for Apartment, 3 BHK, in Aerospace Park / Devanahalli Corridor
turns.note: Brigade Eldorado's 3 BHK is ₹89L–₹166L in unit_configs. ₹31L is its 1 BHK — a configuration this buyer did not ask for.

expect.why: no 3 BHK here is inside ₹50–70L; the fit claim is about a different unit than the one asked for

turns.note: Asked for a price. The dev run answered with stamp duty, registration and GST — on topic, not an answer.

expect.why: a price question must come back with a price

turns.note: The dev run replied with an IT park and a mall.

expect.why: the reply must mention the thing that was asked about

turns.note: A follow-up inside compare mode. The dev run re-printed the whole comparison verbatim.

expect.why: a narrowing follow-up should narrow, not repeat the full compare

turns.note: Answering 'where are you coming from?' with a day. The dev run took it as the origin: 'From Sunday, Brigade Eldorado is your nearer first stop.'

expect.why: a weekday is not a place; the origin slot must reject it and re-ask
